name: motion-studio
description: Motion Studio: deterministic HTML/CSS/JS-to-video (mp4/webm/gif/prores/png-sequence, alpha support) with an MCP server for AI agents, a Studio web UI, a CLI, and pluggable speech/music/transcription vendors. This root package is the GitHub-URL install wrapper (vendor-boundary plan §10.7): `npm install github:bettertogethersoftware/motion-studio` — the engine itself lives in engine/, and engine/package.json stays the development harness (tests, scripts). The dependency lists are mirrored and drift-guarded by engine/test/root-package.test.js.
